invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.0925（基于ATR 0.0007调整，入场价+1.6%保护利润），或融资费率Z-score回落至<50%（多头压力缓解），或Qlib评分跌出前三。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.0925 (adjusted based on ATR 0.0007, entry +1.6% to protect profits), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or Qlib score falls out of top 3.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2300（基于ATR 23.56调整，约-3%），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（空头压力缓解），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2300 (adjusted based on ATR 23.56, ~-3%), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (short pressure eases), or Qlib score falls out of top 3, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50).
